evals.expected_output: One self-contained HTML page with annotated screenshots of the Settings → Output screen, a table of its controls, ranked rough edges and a code map; dev servers stopped and no settings saved.

evals.prompt: Give me a visual walkthrough of the install guide page in cloud/install-guide/ before I rework it.
